name: Wall of Lava
description:
Concentration, up to 3 rounds.

You create a wall of lava within medium range that is 10 ft high, 5 ft thick, and up to 30 ft long or a circular wall with a diameter of short range. Uncheck any number of Conditions and roll Spirit to set the Difficulty.

Each creature that enters the wall, begins its turn within the wall, or is within the wall when it's created must roll Dexterity against the Difficulty. On a failure, the creature takes 1d10 damage, rolls Injury, and is pushed out of the wall in a direction you choose. On a pass, it takes half damage, does not roll Injury, and is pushed out of the wall in a direction it chooses.

For each Condition you unchecked (twice for Angry and Guilty), choose one:

  • The wall becomes 10 ft longer or taller, or the diameter increases by 10 ft.

  • +1d damage.

  • Whenever you maintain concentration for this spell, you may move the wall or part of the wall an additional 5 ft in any direction you choose.

Describe how you create the wall.
successes:
✨: Whenever a creature takes damage from the wall, it rolls Injury one additional time.

🌞: Whenever a creature fails its roll against the Difficulty, it is grappled by the wall. If it attempts to escape the grapple, it rolls against the Difficulty.
